topics.name: Precalculus Foundations
topics.description: Review gate: the algebra, functions, and trigonometry the whole course stands on.

subtopics.name: Functions, domain, and range
subtopics.description: Function notation, evaluating functions, finding domains and ranges.

subtopics.name: Composite and inverse functions
subtopics.description: Building and decomposing composite functions; existence and computation of inverses.

subtopics.name: Polynomial and rational functions and their graphs
subtopics.description: Roots, factoring, end behavior, asymptote intuition for rational functions.

subtopics.name: Exponential and logarithmic functions and their properties
subtopics.description: Laws of exponents and logarithms, solving exponential/log equations, graphs.

subtopics.name: Trigonometric functions and the unit circle
subtopics.description: Radian measure, the six trig functions, exact values, periodicity, graphs.

subtopics.name: Fundamental trigonometric identities
subtopics.description: Pythagorean, sum/difference, double-angle, half-angle identities.

subtopics.name: Inverse trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: Definitions, restricted domains, principal values, graphs.

subtopics.name: Solving equations and inequalities
subtopics.description: Algebraic, absolute-value, and sign-chart methods for inequalities.

subtopics.name: Absolute value and piecewise-defined functions
subtopics.description: Working with piecewise definitions; |x| as a piecewise function.

subtopics.name: Shifting, scaling, and reflecting graphs
subtopics.description: Recognizing f(x−a)+b, cf(x), f(cx), −f(x), f(−x) transformations.

topics.name: Limits and Continuity
topics.description: The foundational concept of calculus: limiting behavior of functions and what it means to be continuous.

subtopics.name: The intuitive idea of a limit; numerical and graphical estimation
subtopics.description: Reading limits off graphs and tables; when limits fail to exist.

subtopics.name: One-sided limits
subtopics.description: Left- and right-hand limits and their relation to two-sided limits.

subtopics.name: Limit laws and algebraic evaluation of limits
subtopics.description: Sum/product/quotient laws; factoring, conjugates, and simplification tricks.

subtopics.name: The squeeze (sandwich) theorem
subtopics.description: Bounding a function to force a limit; classic oscillation examples.

subtopics.name: Special trigonometric limits
subtopics.description: sin(x)/x → 1 and (1−cos x)/x → 0, and limits built from them.

subtopics.name: Infinite limits and vertical asymptotes
subtopics.description: Limits that grow without bound; locating vertical asymptotes.

subtopics.name: Limits at infinity and horizontal asymptotes
subtopics.description: End behavior of rational, exponential, and root functions.

subtopics.name: The precise (epsilon–delta) definition of a limit
subtopics.description: Formal definition; writing epsilon–delta proofs for simple limits.

subtopics.name: Continuity at a point and on an interval
subtopics.description: The three-part definition; continuity of standard function classes.

subtopics.name: Classifying discontinuities
subtopics.description: Removable, jump, and infinite discontinuities; repairing removable ones.

subtopics.name: The Intermediate Value Theorem and its applications
subtopics.description: Statement, hypotheses, and using the IVT to locate roots.

topics.name: The Derivative: Definition and Basic Rules
topics.description: What a derivative is, and the core rules for computing derivatives of algebraic functions.

subtopics.name: Average versus instantaneous rate of change
subtopics.description: Secant vs tangent slopes; rates of change in physical contexts.

subtopics.name: The derivative as a limit of difference quotients
subtopics.description: Computing derivatives from the definition; where derivatives fail to exist.

subtopics.name: Tangent lines and slopes of curves
subtopics.description: Finding equations of tangent lines at a point.

subtopics.name: Differentiability and its relation to continuity
subtopics.description: Corners, cusps, vertical tangents; differentiable implies continuous.

subtopics.name: The derivative as a function; higher-order derivatives
subtopics.description: Sketching f′ from f; second and higher derivatives.

subtopics.name: Derivative notations and their meaning
subtopics.description: Leibniz (dy/dx), Lagrange (f′), and dot notation; when each is used.

subtopics.name: The power rule
subtopics.description: Differentiating x^n for integer, rational, and real exponents.

subtopics.name: Constant multiple and sum/difference rules
subtopics.description: Linearity of differentiation; differentiating polynomials.

subtopics.name: The product rule
subtopics.description: Statement, use, and derivation of the product rule.

subtopics.name: The quotient rule
subtopics.description: Statement and use; deriving it from the product rule.

topics.name: Chain Rule and Derivatives of Transcendental Functions
topics.description: Differentiating compositions and the trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic families.

subtopics.name: The chain rule
subtopics.description: Differentiating composite functions, including nested compositions.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of the six trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: d/dx of sin, cos, tan, cot, sec, csc; deriving sin′ from special limits.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of exponential functions and the number e
subtopics.description: Why e is special; differentiating e^x and a^x.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of logarithmic functions
subtopics.description: Differentiating ln x and log_a x, including composite arguments.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: d/dx of arcsin, arccos, arctan and friends.

subtopics.name: Hyperbolic functions and their derivatives
subtopics.description: sinh, cosh, tanh: definitions, identities, derivatives.

subtopics.name: Differentiating functions that combine all rule families
subtopics.description: Fluently choosing and combining product, quotient, and chain rules.

topics.name: Advanced Differentiation Techniques
topics.description: Differentiation beyond y = f(x): implicit relations, parametric curves, and logarithmic tricks.

subtopics.name: Implicit differentiation
subtopics.description: Differentiating relations like x² + y² = 25; finding dy/dx implicitly.

subtopics.name: Logarithmic differentiation
subtopics.description: Differentiating products, quotients, and f(x)^g(x) via logarithms.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of inverse functions
subtopics.description: The formula (f⁻¹)′(b) = 1/f′(a) and its geometric meaning.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of parametric curves

subtopics.name: Tangent and normal lines to implicit and parametric curves

subtopics.name: Second derivatives of implicit relations

subtopics.name: Absolute and local extrema; critical points

subtopics.name: The Extreme Value Theorem
subtopics.description: Statement and hypotheses; why continuity on a closed interval matters.

subtopics.name: Rolle's Theorem
subtopics.description: Statement, geometric meaning, and applications to roots of f′.

subtopics.name: The Mean Value Theorem and its consequences
subtopics.description: Statement and proof from Rolle's; consequences (f′=0 implies constant).

subtopics.name: Monotonicity and the first derivative test
subtopics.description: Increasing/decreasing intervals; classifying extrema from sign of f′.

subtopics.name: Concavity, inflection points, and the second derivative test

subtopics.name: Complete curve sketching

subtopics.name: Newton's method for approximating roots

subtopics.name: Error propagation and sensitivity via differentials
